integrity: Exact finite exhaustive classification, with independently coded definition-based and greedy-membership enumerators; neither external independent validation nor external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exhaustive theorem treats ternary words only through length eleven; the two verifier programs and exact finite-loop justification provide reproducibility, not conclusions for longer words. An unindexed equivalent result remains a literature risk.
